name: context-canvas-codex
description: Continuable task maps with long-tool-call initialization and policy-sanitized historical snapshots for Codex App and CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Checkpoint long calls, continue maps, and archive snapshots.
interface.longDescription: Keeps session provenance separate from a continuable semantic task lineage and a local PostToolUse snapshot store. The bundled skill initializes a Canvas before any tool call reasonably expected to exceed five minutes, regardless of task type, while hooks remain identity-only. Task maps reopen without destructive mismatch errors, explicit continuation preserves a hash-bound predecessor, and recent canvases plus filtered snapshot history remain discoverable. Snapshots use explicit textual-redaction and opaque-media policies, content addressing, deduplication, bounded retention, and explicit export.
defaultPrompt: Create or restore the task map for this work, including automatic initialization before a tool call expected to exceed five minutes.
If Context Canvas hook identity is missing, check and manually approve its first-install definitions in /hooks before reinstalling or rebooting.
List my recent task canvases and continue the relevant lineage here.
Search this task map or historical tool snapshots and prepare a closeout or policy-sanitized export.
